title: BielGG's Spells Addon
description: An Iron's Spells, T.O, Roaring and Cataclysm addon integration.
body:

# GG Spells needs the following mods to work:

Iron's spells 'n spellbooks
Roaring
L_Ender's Cataclysm
Curios API

## This mod also focuses on integrating Newer Cataclysm with older addons, such as T.O and Cataclysm: Spellbooks. If you see any kind of problem, report on the comments!

 

BielGG's Spells Addon is a mod that focuses heavily on integrating the magical world of "Iron's Spells" with the dark power of "Roaring" and other fantasical elements. This includes a new magic school called "Shadow" and "Unstable" featuring 16 spells shadow, 8 spells unstable and its own dedicated Spellbook for each!

"Roaring" items, such as "The Roaring Blade" and "Shadow Mantle," have been updated to support the Shadow magic school.

Boss Moveset:




<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The Broken Script's moveset
Phase 1
File Collection: When used, the boss will rush towards their target and capture them inside of its tornado, applying damage on contact and releasing the target up to the air. If the target is a PLAYER, it'll release a corrupted clone of the player that have 1000 health and your spells, but it can only last for 1 minute.
Unstable Blink: When used, the boss will start teleporting around the target, leaving Unstable bombs behind that explodes and deals damage.
LASER.EX3: When used, the boss will start channeling a beam, making it stand still for a moment. Upon shooting, the Laser will damage multiple entities at reach and destroy the path. Entities will find themselfes stuck from each hit. Block around the laser will corrupt heavily.
Earth Corruption: When used, the boss will take flight and suck nearby blocks around him. Then, it'll start shooting the blocks at the target.
Corrupted Projectiles: When used, the boss will take flight and start shooting projectiles at the target. If target gets hit, slowness and weakness will be applied for a short period of time. If the projectiles hits blocks, the blocks will corrupt aswell.
Phase 2
The boss will always try not to stay close from a player, beacuse if so, player will be able to sneak themselves inside of the tornado, being able to hit its WEAK POINT. Any hit coming from outside is heavily protected.
Unstable Bombardment: When used, the boss will start shooting Unstable bombs for the target. It'll shoot for every direction aswell.
Earth Corruption: Boss can now shoot blocks nonstop at all targets near him. The tornado can now destroy every block that it touches, being able to suck it and throw at target.
Corrupted Projectiles: Boss will start shooting projectiles upwards, making a rain of projectiles that can corrupt the entire place and hit multiple targets at its way.

</details>
